title: Tiered enterprise security commitments: packaging, pricing experiments, and contract SLAs for SSO/SAML & RBAC
creator: Ava Thompson
description: Define a tiered packaging strategy and run pricing/commitment experiments to determine how to include SSO/SAML and RBAC as contract-level commitments. Outcome: a clear set of SKU/contract promises (time-to-onboard, response SLA, configuration scope) and experiment results to inform product rollout and legal language.
context: We routinely see SSO/SAML and RBAC called out as pre-sales blockers in enterprise security questionnaires. Current ask from Sales: be able to commit to SSO integration timelines and a minimum RBAC feature set in contract language for >$100k ACV deals. Engineering capacity for dedicated onboarding varies; Legal wants constrained, testable commitments rather than open-ended statements.
scope: Draft 2 alternate packaging options (Lite, Standard, Advanced) that map SSO/SAML and RBAC commitments to price bands
Design two pricing experiments to test willingness-to-pay and conversion uplift when committing to onboarding timelines and RBAC guarantees
Align with Legal on contract language templates and required security questionnaire artifacts
Identify eng implementation/design work required to meet commitments and estimate SLA obligations
success_metrics: Win-rate improvement in enterprise RFPs that request SSO/SAML+RBAC (target +10ppt)
Reduction in pre-sales custom contract add-ons (target -30%)
Validated price elasticity from experiments (point estimates for willingness to pay)
deliverables: Packaging doc with SKU mapping to commitments and price ranges (Confluence link)
Two experiment designs + pricing matrix and survey templates
Legal-approved contract clause drafts for SSO/SAML onboarding timelines and RBAC scope
Engineering effort estimate and prioritized work items (to feed ENG backlog)
Responses and exemplar attachments for standard security questionnaire items
acceptance_criteria: Confluence packaging page reviewed and approved by Sales, Legal, and Security
Experiment design reviewed and scheduled with Growth for rollout to top-of-funnel and sales-assisted opportunities
Contract clause language accepted by Legal and added to template library
Engineering estimates added to ENG backlog with clear owners and milestones
comments: 2026-02-28 - Ava Thompson: Initial ticket created after QBR with Sales. Sales reported 7 deals lost in last 90 days explicitly due to lack of committed SSO onboarding timelines and unclear RBAC guarantees.

2026-03-02 - Marcus Lee: Met with Legal (J. Patel) to outline acceptable commitment scope. Legal prefers timeboxed onboarding commitments (e.g., 'SSO setup within 45 business days for Enterprise Lite') plus a clearly enumerated RBAC feature checklist to avoid vague SLAs.

2026-03-05 - Product meeting notes: Proposal to test two variants: (A) price includes 45-day SSO onboarding + basic RBAC; (B) higher price includes 15-day fast onboarding + advanced RBAC + dedicated onboarding engineer. Experiment will run on inbound leads flagged by AE as 'enterprise' and on a funnel cohort in the hosted signup flow.
2026-03-08 - Design feedback (DES-317): UX must include a pre-contract checklist and onboarding checklist PDF that can be attached to the quote. Also recommended copy for sales one-pager.
2026-03-10 - Eng sync (ENG-4821): Engineering estimates ~6 sprint-seconds of work to stabilize SAML metadata import and admin RBAC UI scaffolding; deeper RBAC policy work scoped separately.

2026-03-12 - Legal review: Draft clause posted to Drive (drive.google.com/example-contract-clause). Legal requests that commitments include a force-majeure carveout and defined remediation steps if timelines slip.
2026-03-13 - Pricing spreadsheet: Link (drive.google.com/pricing-expt-6332). Growth proposed A/B of +18% list price on Variant B. Need to target 120 qualified prospects for statistical significance.

2026-03-14 - Next steps assigned: Marcus -> finalize experiment gating & rollout plan; Sales Enablement -> prepare deal one-pager; ENG -> create sub-issues for onboarding automation and RBAC admin flow.
